# Ask HR Agent — Delivery Runbook

## Prerequisites

| Recipe prerequisite | Recorded requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Copilot Studio plugin | mcs-assistant@copilot-studio-plugin |
| Minimum PAC CLI version | 2.9.3 |
| Authoring mode | cli-copilot |
| Portable tool to verify | AskHRAgent |
| Build workload | 22 captured manual build steps · 6 skills · 2 knowledge files · 5 acceptance checks · 6 locked cases |

### Delivery prerequisites

| Requirement | Confirm before building |
| --- | --- |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm licensing for your tenant and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness. Building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication; obtain administrator approval. |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved Ask HR environment, publisher prefix and maker access. Confirm the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available; keep the workshop synthetic and Draft. |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review policies for uploaded HR documents, proposed production sources and the intended channel. Document blocked paths; do not bypass them to complete the demo. |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always authentication trigger. Record who may build, test and later use Ask HR. |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for proposed HRIS, benefits and policy connections, with approved identities and least-privilege references. No customer connection is needed for the synthetic workshop. |
| Test identities | Prepare employee, manager, HR-reviewer and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment. Makers use Draft Preview; do not publish the workshop just to enable sharing. |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane: Copilot Studio browser and reviewed files. Easy mode: VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer. |
| Policy and decision ownership | Have the HR owner identify authoritative policy and benefits sources and the approved route for personal determinations. Keep real employee records out of workshop knowledge and public evidence. |

### Delivery roles

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| HR business owner | Approve the policy sources, employee-facing scope and escalation workflow; agree production success measures without treating fictional balances as customer results. |
| Authorized HR and benefits reviewers | Verify eligibility, exceptions and plan rules through the approved HR workflow; retain decisions that the policy-explanation and draft skills must not make. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and six skills; remove web search, preserve model parity and record the owned agent's Draft state. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm tenant licensing and capacity, maker access, authenticated audience and data policies before approving any HR production connection. |
| HR source and connection owners | Approve HRIS, benefits and policy access; record each connection identity and least-privilege reference, and resolve access failures before a production test. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check HR-01 through HR-06, the refusal tests and Easy/Manual parity; reject missing citations, incomplete inventory captures and Draft badges belonging to other agents. |
| Operations owner | Own production support, session and credit monitoring, and configuration recovery; send individualized HR determinations to the authorized reviewers. |

## Phase 1 — Easy Mode with GitHub Copilot

Choose one of three alternative build lanes: GitHub Copilot authors the source-controlled Draft here. After this lane, continue to Phase 4.

1. Open GitHub Copilot Chat in VS Code, select Agent mode, and attach the [Copilot-only workshop skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md).

2. Send the reviewed messages below in order. The skill verifies the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC prerequisites; inspect its resulting project and evidence.

### Shared build messages

From [EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md — 2. Build and test the solution](../../solutions/ask-hr/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md#2-build-and-test-the-solution):

```text
Give me Ask HR using Easy Mode and test it for me.
```

From [EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md — 3. Deploy the validated Draft](../../solutions/ask-hr/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md#3-deploy-the-validated-draft):

```text
Deploy it into Copilot Studio for me.
```

3. Check the Draft against the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#skill-inventory): 6 skills and 2 knowledge files. Use synthetic inputs only; neither publication nor live-system connections belong in this lane.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The source-controlled build uses cli-copilot in the approved environment and remains Draft. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json)
- [ ] This lane's HR Preview results identify the agent, model, inventory and Draft state. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

## Phase 2 — Optional Brainstem Track

Choose one of three alternative build lanes: this optional track adds local Brainstem validation. It is not a prerequisite for the browser build; continue to Phase 4 when it is complete.

1. Attach the [Brainstem workshop skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-brainstem/SKILL.md) instead of the Copilot-only skill.

2. Reuse the [shared build messages from Phase 1](#shared-build-messages); do not repeat that lane separately.

3. Follow [the local installation recipe](../../solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json) for `ask_hr_agent.py`. Verify `AskHRAgent` at `http://localhost:7071/health` and run its smoke test.

4. Use the [locked acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) for isolated local runs. Record the actual results, then complete target Draft validation. [Full optional-track procedure](../../solutions/ask-hr/EASY-MODE-PERSONLESS.md).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] If this lane is chosen, the recipe smoke test calls `AskHRAgent` and returns its required markers. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json)
- [ ] Record optional-track completion or non-use; do not claim validation for an omitted lane. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

## Phase 3 — Manual Build in Copilot Studio

Choose one of three alternative build lanes: build the agent directly in the Copilot Studio browser. No Python, local runtime, CLI import or earlier build lane is required.

1. Create a blank Draft in the approved environment and record the agent identity.

2. Copy and save the reviewed [global instructions](../../solutions/ask-hr/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md), including all source and action limits.

3. Upload the 2 content files from the [knowledge inventory](2.Architecture.md#knowledge-inventory); wait for ingestion to finish.

4. Upload each of the 6 files from the [skill inventory](2.Architecture.md#skill-inventory) once. Correct only genuine validation errors; do not manufacture an error to reproduce an old screenshot.

5. Match the recorded model `Sonnet46` and the reviewed input restrictions. Confirm the saved state and complete inventory before Preview.

6. Run each [locked prompt](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) in a fresh Preview conversation. Capture current-agent results and keep the agent unpublished.

For the exact UI sequence and conditional checkpoints, use the [manual tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/ask-hr/manual-tutorial.html).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The manual build has reviewed instructions, two knowledge files, six skills and the confirmed model; web search and tools are absent. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/evals/manual-build-evidence.json)
- [ ] Unchanged HR prompts pass in fresh Preview chats on the owned, unpublished manual agent. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

## Phase 4 — Acceptance

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** expected names, identifiers, and figures below are fictional test evidence, not customer results.

- [ ] Replay all 6 locked cases (HR-01, HR-02, HR-03, HR-04, HR-05, HR-06) from the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix), then the [refusal and escalation tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases). Compare the final responses, not approximate wording or an old recorded pass.

### Go / no-go

| Criterion | Required threshold | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Locked HR corpus | All six cases, HR-01 through HR-06, satisfy every required and forbidden marker. | [ask-hr.json](../../tests/demo_cases/ask-hr.json) |
| Manual inventory | Two knowledge files, six skills and the reviewed model; no tools or web search. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/ask-hr/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |
| Privacy and human authority | Any sensitive inference, eligibility decision, plan recommendation, submission or notification is no-go. | [GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md](../../solutions/ask-hr/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md) |
| Visual checkpoint acceptance | Require a visible target-state anchor without a defeating blocker; withhold reshoot-required captures. | [visual-checkpoints.json](../../solutions/ask-hr/evals/visual-checkpoints.json) |
| Release state | The owned workshop agent is Draft with `published: false`. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/ask-hr/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Full-response assertions establish each HR case pass; cropped screenshots do not replace the machine gate. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/evals/visual-checkpoints.json)
- [ ] Chosen-lane evidence is complete; any Easy/Manual comparison uses identical instructions, knowledge, skills and model. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

## Phase 5 — Production Hardening

This is a separately approved production workstream, not another synthetic build step. Use the [qualified seams](2.Architecture.md#production-replacement-seams) as its integration boundary.

1. **Qualify — HR business owner.** Agree HR replacement connections, governance, support, telemetry and success measures before production. [Basis](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

2. **Secure — Power Platform administrator.** Approve document, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify blocked routes stay blocked. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention)

3. **Connect — HR source and connection owners.** Create dedicated references only for approved HR systems and verify least-privilege access. [Basis](../../solutions/catalog.json)

4. **Test — Acceptance reviewer.** Test an approved deployment as intended HR users and an unshared identity; maker access does not prove user connection access. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent)

5. **Release: ALM — Copilot Studio maker.** Back up the reviewed workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then package with `pac copilot pack`. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/developer/cli/reference/copilot)

6. **Release: recovery — Power Platform administrator.** Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/backup-restore-environments)

7. **Release: approval — HR business owner.** Require explicit confirmation before the production publish operation. [Basis](../../solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json)

8. **Operate — Operations owner.** Review HR session transcripts, failed interactions, tool authentication errors and credit usage in Monitor. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] HR production replacements, governance, telemetry, support and success measures are agreed. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] The recovery rehearsal uses a restore path supported for the chosen environment type and target. [Source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/backup-restore-environments)
- [ ] The production publish operation has explicit human confirmation. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json)

## Failure Recovery

| Risk | Recovery action |
| --- | --- |
| [1](1.Overview.md#what-actually-goes-wrong) | Restore the reviewed inventory; recapture all six skills, both knowledge files, model and saved state. |
| [2](1.Overview.md#what-actually-goes-wrong) | Recapture a saved-state indicator; visible policy text alone does not prove saving. |
| [3](1.Overview.md#what-actually-goes-wrong) | Withhold it and capture the named Ask HR agent with its own Draft badge. |
| [4](1.Overview.md#what-actually-goes-wrong) | Validate the complete final response against HR-02's exact markers; a readable crop is not a full-case pass. |
| [5](1.Overview.md#what-actually-goes-wrong) | Use the named skill. If loading still fails after one retry, report it and stop without an uncited answer. |

## Deliverables Checklist

- [ ] The Ask HR Agent Draft identity, `Sonnet46` model and chosen lane are recorded.
- [ ] The 6 skills and 2 knowledge files match the Architecture inventory.
- [ ] Fresh results are retained for HR-01, HR-02, HR-03, HR-04, HR-05, HR-06.
- [ ] The 8 authored boundary tests have reviewer-recorded outcomes.
- [ ] The solution's go/no-go decision identifies remaining risks, accountable owners and the publication boundary.
